opportunities.description: Matilda Cleveland provides transitional housing for single parents and their children experiencing homelessness. Services provided include: life skills training, case management, enrichment activities for youth, and connections to community resources.

opportunities.title: Get emergency shelter for people who are experiencing homelessness
opportunities.description: Insight Housing's emergency shelter programs offer a safe place to stay with warm meals, for adults experiencing homelessness. The shelter also provides shower and laundry facilities, access to computers and telephones, and housing case managers.

opportunities.title: Get help finding shelter and stable housing for Veterans
opportunities.description: Insight Housing’s Roads Home program works to help end homelessness among veterans and their families. Services include temporary financial assistance, housing search and placement, case management, transitional and permanent supportive housing, health care navigation, employment services and HUD-VASH voucher administration.
